description: Get one blog post by the id list_blog_posts or search gave: title, kind, author, date and the text. Articles, news and press releases from Canton, Digital Asset and the Canton Foundation and network notices are returned in full; reprints and partner press are returned as an excerpt with a link to the original, the same as the website. Pass offset to keep reading a long post past the first part.

chars.description: Characters of text to return. Default 12000; raise it (max 200000) for the whole post, or set 0 for metadata only.

offset.description: Character position to start reading from, for a long post. The response names the offset that continues the read.

name: get_blog_post
